name: Yantai Eddie Precision Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Yantai Eddie Precision Machinery Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, production, and sale of hydraulic attachments for construction machinery and marines in China. The company offers hydraulic breakers, including conventional and special breakers; plier accessories, which include hydraulic shears, crushing pliers, hawkbill scissors, and car removal pliers; gripping tolls; vibration accessories; and quick connect devices. It also provides high-end hydraulic parts; industrial robots; carbide cutting tools; and battery energy storage. In addition, the company offers after-market products and services.
